usedFor: Every Shopify order becomes an invoice in QuickBooks without re-keying.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Invoice” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: “New Order” is pushed as the sale happens, and “Create Invoice” records it for bookkeeping.

watchOut: “Create Payment” has no matching Shopify payment trigger, so check what you map into it.
